images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE 1536×1024 raster sprite effect sheet for FROZEN ORB. Flat PURE BLACK #000000 background, exactly 6 columns × 4 rows of 256×256 cells, 24 drawings total. Each drawing centred in its own cell with clear empty margins and never touching any cell edge. GREYSCALE ONLY, exactly FIVE permitted values: #000000 background, #404040 dark grey, #808080 mid grey, #C0C0C0 light grey, #FFFFFF white. Hand-painted small-native-size sprite aesthetic, hard stair-stepped shapes as if drawn with a 1-px pencil at 64×64 per cell and enlarged 4× with nearest-neighbour. 3–4 flat value steps within each drawing, white core, dark grey rim/interior holes. ABSOLUTELY NO soft gradients, glow, haze, bloom, radial light falloff, blur, anti-aliasing or outline strokes. Every mark must be a solid hard-edged block in the five-value palette. For luminosity use solid light-grey blocks, never a glow. Ice/frost design with crystals, shards and stylized frost mist represented ONLY by discrete solid clusters. Readable at 25% size, 64px cells.
ROW 1 — CAST, six frames left to right in time: a swirl of frost gathering at a point, growing from a few motes into a bright compact orb with white core.
ROW 2 — TRAVEL, six frames: orb in flight facing RIGHT, bright crystalline sphere with short frost-mist streak trailing LEFT. Vary spinning facets and solid-cluster mist across frames to form a loop.
ROW 3 — IMPACT, six frames: frame 1 flat white flash disc; then radial ice shards burst outward with a ring; then shards thin and ring breaks; last frame a few small dark fragments. All rings are hard stepped bands, all debris remains inside each cell.
ROW 4 — RESIDUAL + SHARD, six frames: first four cells show a ground frost patch, flat ellipse wider than tall, fading in discrete value steps. Cells 5 and 6 show one single ice shard projectile facing RIGHT, small bright dart with tiny solid-cluster mist tail, two spin variants.
No labels, grid lines, text, border or anything between cells. No colour. Pure black background everywhere outside the hard-edged effect shapes. Deliver exactly 1536×1024.

concerns: Followed the task-specific black-background, greyscale 6×4 specification, which conflicts with the frozen register's green-background, hand-drawn 2×2 requirements.
Exact five-value palette and absence of anti-aliasing were not verified pixel-by-pixel.
Residual frost frames 3 and 4 show limited visible value fading.
